test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A great transition / marked / the 20th century / for mankind

options.text: A great transition marked the 20th century for mankind.
The 20th century marked a great transition for mankind.
A great transition for mankind marked the 20th century.
For mankind, a great transition marked the 20th century.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The 20th**** century marked a great transition for mankind**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A ***meaningful sentence*** is one that uses details to clarify the meaning of a term.
 
• A relevant sentence demonstrates that the author knows the word's meaning and can apply it in a ***communicative context***.
 
• The first part would be** "the 20th century" **which starts the sentence and acts as the subject.
 
• The second part would be **"marked" **which acts as the verb of the sentence.
 
• The third part would be **"A great transition" **which will act as the object of the sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**The​​ *complete sentence* is:__ ***The 20th century marked a great transition for mankind.​*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• A*** sentence*** is a group or combination of words.
 
• To make sense, the words must be placed in a coherent order that includes ***subject + verb + object + predicate***.
 
• The relevant sentence must also be ***grammatically correct***.
